scope: Non-operational computational/structural literature test only; no wet-lab protocol, pathogen engineering, clinical recommendation, or manipulation parameters.

blindness_boundary.meaning: The hypotheses below were frozen before the assistant performs a targeted BMV literature search in this pass.
not_claimed: that equivalent evidence has never been published
that the model has no latent pretraining knowledge of BMV
that a retrospective literature hit constitutes a scientific discovery
that this is prospective experimental validation

derivation_basis: JANUS Mirror-Reverse typed debt framework from C023/C024
cross-system observation that apparently symmetric capsids can conceal functionally asymmetric cargo-shell or unique-vertex structure
rule that shell-only state vocabularies may erase reverse-relevant information

pre_frozen_hypotheses.prediction: A shell-only representation of BMV will be insufficient to explain genome-containing particle assembly/disassembly or stability; RNA/cargo-shell interactions will act as a distinct state/context variable rather than passive payload.
Icosahedral/symmetry-averaged structural descriptions of BMV will omit functionally relevant asymmetric or non-equivalent RNA-capsid organization, packaging, or release information.

Forward assembly and reverse disassembly/uncoating will not be fully characterized by identical state/edge contracts; at least one direction-dependent intermediate, kinetic barrier, or context dependency should be required at a useful experimental resolution.

If published BMV evidence instead supports the same effective states and transition relationships in both directions at the reported resolution, JANUS must return MIRROR_COMPATIBLE_AT_RESOLUTION rather than force a debt verdict.

scoring.HIT: targeted post-freeze literature contains direct evidence matching the pre-frozen mechanism class
scoring.MISS: targeted literature contradicts the hypothesis or supports mirror compatibility
scoring.UNKNOWN: available evidence is insufficient or not directionally comparable
scoring.novelty_rule: A HIT demonstrates only session-level predictive usefulness. It does not establish novelty or scientific breakthrough; equivalent prior art must be credited as prior art.
